brief.scope: Adjudicate Claude e1c454's eight and Daybreak 695db7's two remaining discovery-contract findings; you authored neither revision nor findings. Read owner brief, reports and precise owning passages. Rule each UPHELD/PARTIAL/REJECTED with evidence; prescribe minimal coherent correction groups, preserving verified example payloads where possible. # RULING — discovery contract remaining findings

Adjudicator grok-4.6. Artifact c2596ed078bca713eb311211b5fa40f098a53b68 versus c06ed9442ba51c9e96aa8de9f9bde93d0843a6cc. Contract files are byte-identical to the Claude (87395bd) and Daybreak (531e0e3) review trees. This session authored neither the GPT-6 revision nor the findings. Scope is the read-only conductor discovery contract. No worker server, host isolation, executable tests, or live runtime is demanded. Prior resolved GPT-6 and Daybreak keys are not reopened.

Inputs read whole: in/discovery-contract-owner.md, in/20260906T015906Z-review-claude-e1c454.json, in/20260906T015323Z-review-codex-695db7.json.

## Findings

Claude-1 Selection.complete — UPHELD.
296-297 and D-A17 make missing bindings yield selection unknown and complete false. 313-316 say only enumeration/reading/bindings failures affect complete, and do not say an absent binding is such a failure. 306-307 then yields none for a complete scan with zero current handoffs. 451-453 force unknown=0 when complete is true. One unbound HANDOFF-*.md with empty record_bindings therefore has two required outputs. Correction: an observed unbound handoff is a bindings failure (complete false, selection unknown, counts null). Keep D-A17.

Claude-2 Unbound AARs / shipped defaults — PARTIAL.
317 ("AAR metadata gaps conservatively block selection") contradicts 288 (an AAR never becomes the selected handoff). Four tracked ops/conductor/AAR-*.md files match 171-173, so AAR gaps would poison handoff selection beside a unique bound handoff. That is upheld. The claim that empty shipped bindings defeat owner recovery is rejected: four tracked HANDOFF-*.md files also keep selection unknown under D-A17, and that is honest. Custody README:35-36 and D-A43 already allow exact uncertainty. Do not invent record_bindings for old bytes. Correction: remove 317's AAR-blocks-handoff rule; unbound AARs remain listed and excluded from handoff counts; add a row that one bound current handoff plus unbound AARs still yields one; add a shipped-default HEAD row that empty bindings yield unknown, complete false, four unbound handoffs and four unbound AARs visible.

Claude-3 Lock membership — UPHELD.
470-473 say locked is membership in readable composer.lock for an exact named package and do not pin the site. symfony/workflow occurs at composer.lock:1301 and :1346 as constraint values and zero times as a packages/packages-dev name. Plan:232 lists it lock-absent. A generic scan yields locked true. D-A34 does not pin the site. Correction: locked true only when a packages[] or packages-dev[] object has name exactly equal to the intended package; other JSON locations are not membership; measured absence is false; D-A34 plants a real name entry. Keep workflow-genus locked false on this tree.

Claude-4 Work overflow — UPHELD.
work_bindings allows 20 entries (115). Startup returns the first eight and "work omitted: N" (525-526, 536). Queries 483-488 have no work query. Tool count is 11, so a fifth query is not the fix. Correction: optional cursor on lane_start pages only work; page one remains the current eight-card startup envelope; later pages return the next work slice under the 8192 cap without dropping owners. Add a 20-binding row that omitted cards are reachable. Keep fixture A's empty work array and tool count 11.

Claude-5 Contract revision — UPHELD.
228 digests compiled card/shape/law/action data; 387-389 hashes this contract's trusted Markdown bytes; 394 names only config and adapter as boot-supplied; 360 keeps contract ok after validation. If Markdown is a repo read, a repo failure would make contract unavailable. Examples plant fixture/contract and do not pin the recipe. Correction: contract is a boot-supplied definition source, same class as config/adapter. Observation data stays {protocol:"discovery/3", revision:SHA256} with revision = SHA-256 of launch-supplied discovery-lever.md bytes; that is the 228 digest; no second hash; repo failure does not mark contract unavailable. Keep planted fingerprints.

Claude-6 Home.evidence — UPHELD.
429 declares evidence:[source_id,...] on Home with no derivation. StateSummary is defined at 239-245. The only Home instance is discovery-examples.md:562-565 ["contract","repo"]. Correction: Home.evidence lists contract for the compiled index row and repo iff document_present, implementation_present, or locked was measured or attempted from repo observations; no other source IDs. Unresolved ownership, failed document read, and locked false/null still use that pair when repo was consulted. Keep the wf-runtime example.

Claude-7 Registry null — PARTIAL.
ops/conductor/registry/lane_mcp.py.json exists (tool lane_mcp.py, one config-refusal row). Index 610 leaves lane-mcp registry null, against 458-460. lane-read has no lane_read.py.json, so 611 null is correct. Correction: set lane-mcp registry to ops/conductor/registry/lane_mcp.py.json; leave lane-read null; step 2 still appends the v3 row to that file.

Claude-8 Mapping heading — UPHELD.
Heading "Symfony mapping, remeasured" (conductor-start-plan.md:218) asserts a current measurement. Body 220-224 and discovery-lever.md:652-656 say the table is preserved from invalid record 20260906T011424Z-code-codex-2a2af6 at 3682a8c5, 2026-09-06T01:15:46Z. Rename the heading to historical/preserved. Do not remeasure. Update the fragment at discovery-lever.md:655-656 if the heading slug changes.

Daybreak-1 Trusted config/launch — PARTIAL.
The contract claims trusted launch selects audience and sources and forbids a caller-supplied path (13-23, 109-110, 138). CLI remains --config FILE (539; lane_mcp.py:310-325; v1 baseline lane-mcp-lever.md:43). D-A42 wants a worker unable to obtain the conductor catalogue and also disclaims other-tool enforcement. The ambiguity is real. Rejected: authenticated wrapper, inherited OS capability, or worker-server refusal in this slice. Correction: FILE is a launch-supplied trusted descriptor of the same class as anchors, not a query argument; discovery tools/resources never accept config, audience, role, repository, or path; D-A42 plants two launch-supplied configs (conductor versus job-bound) and a rejected role argument; a process started with the wrong FILE is a launch defect, not a query defect. No sandbox or worker MCP is specified.

Daybreak-2 Hostile body before transport — UPHELD, limited.
Named Candidate.body carries the hostile 64-byte fixture verbatim (discovery-examples.md:633-635). lane_mcp.py:237-256 returns that envelope as MCP text and structuredContent. 321-327 require a later consumer renderer to escape markers, after the model seam. D-A32 already says JSON escaping is insufficient. Correction: the projection wraps body on every surface (CLI, tool, resource, structuredContent) before emit. Wrap: begin line naming key and revision; raw UTF-8 body; end line END UNTRUSTED RECORD. Escape by prefixing any inner line that equals that end marker with one > and repeating until the line does not equal the marker. revision, key, and body_bytes remain the inner 64-byte record (keep 1b8fdd01…, e069b33f…, 64). Update only the named-record example body string and its envelope byte count. D-A32 compares the literal emitted body. Limit: delimiting is a boundary label, not semantic injection resistance; corroboration at 326-327 still applies.

## Correction groups

1. Selection and AAR/handoff defaults (Claude-1 UPHELD, Claude-2 PARTIAL): discovery-lever.md:296-317, 449-453, D-A17; add D-A17b and shipped-HEAD row.
2. Lock name-site (Claude-3 UPHELD): discovery-lever.md:470-476, D-A34.
3. Work paging on lane_start (Claude-4 UPHELD): discovery-lever.md:115, 483-488, 520-536; add reachability row; keep tools 11.
4. Contract fingerprint and Home.evidence (Claude-5, Claude-6 UPHELD): discovery-lever.md:228, 360, 387-394, 426-429; keep planted fingerprints and examples.md:562-565.
5. Launch descriptor versus query (Daybreak-1 PARTIAL): discovery-lever.md:13-23, 105-138, 539-549, D-A42. Do not edit lane_mcp.py in this docs slice.
6. Pre-transport untrusted wrap (Daybreak-2 UPHELD): discovery-lever.md:321-327, 439-448, D-A32; discovery-examples.md named-record body only.
7. Index labels (Claude-7 PARTIAL, Claude-8 UPHELD): discovery-lever.md:610; conductor-start-plan.md:218 and link at discovery-lever.md:655-656.

Preserve the other seven example envelopes and the fixture/snapshot recipes. No v1/v2 payload change. No source, tests, settings, host, DB, or network work.

## Missed by reviewers

Empty shipped bindings fail unique selection because of four unbound HANDOFFs, not only AARs. D-A43 already admits exact uncertainty. --config FILE is the v1/v2 launch descriptor; a wrapper would be host isolation. lane_mcp.py citations describe the inherited projection v3 will reuse; v3 is ABSENT. lane-read has no registry file. Delimiting cannot prove semantic immunity.
